params.1266: Is There a Fairy Ring Code for Harra Land?
params.1273: Harvest a crop of harralander from a herb patch.
params.1274: Harralander seeds can be pickpocketed from master farmers (with sufficient Thieving), bought, found in nests or dropped from slain monsters.
params.1275: Head to a herb patch to plant them.
params.1276: Once cleaned, herbs are the core of the Herblore skill.
